Alert.desc: +2 to Notice; never surprised (if allowed a Notice roll, acts normally).

Quick.desc: Redraw initiative cards of 5 or lower.

Ace.desc: +2 Piloting; may make Soak rolls for vehicles using Piloting; ignore up to 2 points of vehicle handling penalties.

Dodge.desc: All attackers suffer -1 to hit; -2 on a raise when the hero makes an Agility roll.

First Strike.desc: Once per round, may make a free Fighting attack against one foe who moves adjacent.

Improved First Strike.desc: May use First Strike against every foe who moves adjacent in a round.

Marksman.desc: If the hero does not move, ignore up to 2 points of penalties from range, cover, called shots, and the like.

Trademark Weapon.desc: +1 with one specific named weapon; stacks with other bonuses.

Combat Reflexes.desc: +2 to Spirit rolls to recover from Shaken.

Extraction.desc: Withdrawing from melee does not give adjacent foes a free attack.

Improved Extraction.desc: May withdraw from multiple foes without triggering free attacks.

Counterattack.desc: Once per round, when an adjacent foe misses with a Fighting attack, the hero may immediately make a free Fighting attack against that foe.

Frenzy.desc: Make one extra Fighting attack per round at -2 against a single target.

Improved Frenzy.desc: The -2 penalty from Frenzy is removed.

Investigator.desc: +2 to Research rolls and to Notice when searching for clues or evidence.

Scholar.desc: +2 to two chosen academic skills (Academics, Research, Science, or similar).

Thief.requirements: Novice, Agility d8, Stealth d8, Thievery d6
Thief.desc: +2 to Thievery; treated as carrying basic thieves' tools (lock overrides, slicer kits, bypass spikes).

Woodsman.desc: +2 to Notice and Survival rolls made in wilderness or natural terrain.

McGyver.requirements: Novice, Smarts d6, Notice d8, Repair d6
McGyver.desc: Can improvise tools and simple devices from spare parts; ignore lack-of-tools penalty once per scene.

Strong Willed.desc: +2 to both Smarts and Spirit rolls when resisting Tests of Wills and similar opposed actions.

Very Attractive.desc: +2 to Persuasion and Performance rolls (replaces Attractive bonus).

Command.desc: Allies within 5" (Command Range) add +1 to Spirit rolls to recover from Shaken.

Inspire.desc: With a successful Battle roll, allies in Command Range may remove Shaken and recover 1 Wound.

Connections.desc: Has an insider contact in one organization who can provide occasional information, aid, or access.
